reader_summary.overview: My guest today is John Harris, Managing Partner of Ruane, Cunniff & Goldfarb. In our conversation, we cover John’s approach to finding businesses that can be owned for the long-term, what goes into their diligence process. I think many of the stock pickers will enjoy many of the points on good management, good businesses, and using imagination.
